task.name: Strike_Buffer_Bush
task.when: During Strike after the Buffer Bush closes

step.action: Have the Power Lead de-energize and disconnect the buffers and lighting.
Remove and pack the lighting in its assigned container.
Remove the fur, pad, and tentacle covers.
Put each clean, dry cover group in its assigned clear storage bag.
Remove and pack each disconnected massage buffer in its assigned container.
Deflate each pad using the method printed in 📦 Build_Book.
Pack each pad with its matching cover group.
Dismantle the base in the printed reverse sequence.
Put every fastener and anchor in the Buffer Bush hardware bin.

passWhen.criterion: Every electrical component is de-energized, disconnected, and packed.
Every cover, pad, buffer, base part, fastener, and anchor is accounted for and packed.
The former Buffer Bush footprint is clear and MOOP-free.
